\section[\texorpdfstring{\bn{লক্ষ্য} (lôkkhyô)}{লক্ষ্য (lôkkhyô)}]{\bn{লক্ষ্য} (lôkkhyô) — a goal; an aim}

\label{lesson:BN-C376-lokkhyo}



\begin{quote}
Before the new one: say the Bengali for to impose, then the Bengali for to relax a rule.
\end{quote}

\subsection*{You'll want to know: \bn{লক্ষ্য}}
\textbf{\bn{লক্ষ্য}} — \emph{lôkkhyô} — \textquotedblleft{}a goal; an aim\textquotedblright{}.

\begin{quote}
\bn{যদি} \bn{তোমার} \bn{লক্ষ্য} \bn{বড়} \bn{হয়}, \bn{তাহলে} \bn{তোমাকে} \bn{বেশি} \bn{কাজ} \bn{করতে} \bn{হবে।}
\end{quote}

\begin{quote}
\emph{jôdi tomār lôkkhyô bôṛo hôy, tāhôle tomāke beshi kāj kôrte hôbe.}
\end{quote}

\begin{quote}
If your goal is big, you will have to work harder.
\end{quote}

\begin{cousinweb}
\textbf{\bn{লক্ষ্য}} (\emph{lôkkhyô}) is Sanskrit \emph{lakṣya}, the mark aimed at (Monier-Williams). It is a target in archery and a goal in life.
\end{cousinweb}

\begin{grammarlens}[title={What you've built}]
One more word for saying what happens if.
\end{grammarlens}

\subsection*{Your turn}
\begin{itemize}
\raggedright
  \item \emph{Say it:} \emph{lôkkhyô}
  \item \emph{Say it:} \emph{lôkkhyô}, once more
  \item \emph{Say it:} \emph{jôdi tomār lôkkhyô bôṛo hôy, tāhôle tomāke beshi kāj kôrte hôbe.} — If your goal is big, you will have to work harder.
  \item \emph{Recall:} say the Bengali for to impose, then the Bengali for to relax a rule, then say \emph{lôkkhyô} again
\end{itemize}

\begin{tcolorbox}[breakable,colback=teal!4,colframe=teal!35!black,title={Before you move on}]
What does \bn{লক্ষ্য} mean? (\textquotedblleft{}A goal; an aim\textquotedblright{}.) Say it once more.
\end{tcolorbox}
\section[\texorpdfstring{\bn{চেষ্টা} (cheshṭā)}{চেষ্টা (cheshṭā)}]{\bn{চেষ্টা} (cheshṭā) — an attempt; an effort}

\label{lesson:BN-C376-cheshta}



\begin{quote}
Before the new one: say the Bengali for to relax a rule, then the Bengali for a goal.
\end{quote}

\subsection*{You'll want to know: \bn{চেষ্টা}}
\textbf{\bn{চেষ্টা}} — \emph{cheshṭā} — \textquotedblleft{}an attempt; an effort\textquotedblright{}.

\begin{quote}
\bn{চেষ্টা} \bn{করলে} \bn{তুমি} \bn{পারবে।}
\end{quote}

\begin{quote}
\emph{cheshṭā kôrle tumi pārbe.}
\end{quote}

\begin{quote}
If you try, you'll manage.
\end{quote}

\begin{cousinweb}
\textbf{\bn{চেষ্টা}} (\emph{cheshṭā}) is Sanskrit \emph{ceṣṭā}, effort or exertion (Monier-Williams). With \bn{করা} it is the everyday verb 'to try'.
\end{cousinweb}

\begin{grammarlens}[title={What you've built}]
One more word for saying what happens if.
\end{grammarlens}

\subsection*{Your turn}
\begin{itemize}
\raggedright
  \item \emph{Say it:} \emph{cheshṭā}
  \item \emph{Say it:} \emph{cheshṭā}, once more
  \item \emph{Say it:} \emph{cheshṭā kôrle tumi pārbe.} — If you try, you'll manage.
  \item \emph{Recall:} say the Bengali for to relax a rule, then the Bengali for a goal, then say \emph{cheshṭā} again
\end{itemize}

\begin{tcolorbox}[breakable,colback=teal!4,colframe=teal!35!black,title={Before you move on}]
What does \bn{চেষ্টা} mean? (\textquotedblleft{}An attempt; an effort\textquotedblright{}.) Say it once more.
\end{tcolorbox}
\section[\texorpdfstring{\bn{পরিশ্রম} (pôrishrôm)}{পরিশ্রম (pôrishrôm)}]{\bn{পরিশ্রম} (pôrishrôm) — hard work; effort}

\label{lesson:BN-C376-porishrom}



\begin{quote}
Before the new one: say the Bengali for a goal, then the Bengali for an attempt.
\end{quote}

\subsection*{You'll want to know: \bn{পরিশ্রম}}
\textbf{\bn{পরিশ্রম}} — \emph{pôrishrôm} — \textquotedblleft{}hard work; effort\textquotedblright{}.

\begin{quote}
\bn{পরিশ্রম} \bn{করলে} \bn{তুমি} \bn{ফল} \bn{পাবে।}
\end{quote}

\begin{quote}
\emph{pôrishrôm kôrle tumi phôl pābe.}
\end{quote}

\begin{quote}
If you work hard, you will see results.
\end{quote}

\begin{cousinweb}
\textbf{\bn{পরিশ্রম}} (\emph{pôrishrôm}) is Sanskrit \emph{pariśrama}, exertion or labour (Monier-Williams). The taught \bn{পরিশ্রমী}, hard-working, is built on it.
\end{cousinweb}

\begin{grammarlens}[title={What you've built}]
One more word for saying what happens if.
\end{grammarlens}

\subsection*{Your turn}
\begin{itemize}
\raggedright
  \item \emph{Say it:} \emph{pôrishrôm}
  \item \emph{Say it:} \emph{pôrishrôm}, once more
  \item \emph{Say it:} \emph{pôrishrôm kôrle tumi phôl pābe.} — If you work hard, you will see results.
  \item \emph{Recall:} say the Bengali for a goal, then the Bengali for an attempt, then say \emph{pôrishrôm} again
\end{itemize}

\begin{tcolorbox}[breakable,colback=teal!4,colframe=teal!35!black,title={Before you move on}]
What does \bn{পরিশ্রম} mean? (\textquotedblleft{}Hard work; effort\textquotedblright{}.) Say it once more.
\end{tcolorbox}
\section[\texorpdfstring{\bn{সফল} (sôphôl)}{সফল (sôphôl)}]{\bn{সফল} (sôphôl) — successful}

\label{lesson:BN-C376-sophol}



\begin{quote}
Before the new one: say the Bengali for an attempt, then the Bengali for hard work.
\end{quote}

\subsection*{You'll want to know: \bn{সফল}}
\textbf{\bn{সফল}} — \emph{sôphôl} — \textquotedblleft{}successful\textquotedblright{}.

\begin{quote}
\bn{চেষ্টা} \bn{চালিয়ে} \bn{গেলে} \bn{তুমি} \bn{সফল} \bn{হবে।}
\end{quote}

\begin{quote}
\emph{cheshṭā chāliye gele tumi sôphôl hôbe.}
\end{quote}

\begin{quote}
If you keep trying, you will succeed.
\end{quote}

\begin{cousinweb}
\textbf{\bn{সফল}} (\emph{sôphôl}) is Sanskrit \emph{saphala}, 'with fruit', fruitful (Monier-Williams): an effort that bears fruit. \bn{সফল} \bn{হওয়া} is to succeed.
\end{cousinweb}

\begin{grammarlens}[title={What you've built}]
One more word for saying what happens if.
\end{grammarlens}

\subsection*{Your turn}
\begin{itemize}
\raggedright
  \item \emph{Say it:} \emph{sôphôl}
  \item \emph{Say it:} \emph{sôphôl}, once more
  \item \emph{Say it:} \emph{cheshṭā chāliye gele tumi sôphôl hôbe.} — If you keep trying, you will succeed.
  \item \emph{Recall:} say the Bengali for an attempt, then the Bengali for hard work, then say \emph{sôphôl} again
\end{itemize}

\begin{tcolorbox}[breakable,colback=teal!4,colframe=teal!35!black,title={Before you move on}]
What does \bn{সফল} mean? (\textquotedblleft{}Successful\textquotedblright{}.) Say it once more.

\section[\texorpdfstring{\bn{অর্জন} \bn{করা} (ôrjôn kôrā)}{অর্জন করা (ôrjôn kôrā)}]{\bn{অর্জন} \bn{করা} (ôrjôn kôrā) — to achieve; to earn (a result)}

\label{lesson:BN-C376-orjon-kora}



\begin{quote}
Before the new one: say the Bengali for hard work, then the Bengali for successful.
\end{quote}

\subsection*{You'll want to know: \bn{অর্জন} \bn{করা}}
\textbf{\bn{অর্জন} \bn{করা}} — \emph{ôrjôn kôrā} — \textquotedblleft{}to achieve; to earn (a result)\textquotedblright{}.

\begin{quote}
\bn{পরিশ্রম} \bn{করলে} \bn{তুমি} \bn{বড়} \bn{লক্ষ্যও} \bn{অর্জন} \bn{করতে} \bn{পারবে।}
\end{quote}

\begin{quote}
\emph{pôrishrôm kôrle tumi bôṛo lôkkhyôo ôrjôn kôrte pārbe.}
\end{quote}

\begin{quote}
With hard work you can achieve even a big goal.
\end{quote}

Past (he/she …): \bn{তিনি} \bn{অনেক} \bn{সাফল্য} \bn{অর্জন} \bn{করলেন}, \emph{tini ônek sāphôlyô ôrjôn kôrlen}.

\begin{cousinweb}
\textbf{\bn{অর্জন} \bn{করা}} (\emph{ôrjôn kôrā}) is Sanskrit \emph{arjana}, acquiring or earning (Monier-Williams), with \bn{করা}: to win a goal, a prize or a reputation by effort.
\end{cousinweb}

\begin{grammarlens}[title={What you've built}]
One more word for saying what happens if.
\end{grammarlens}

  \item \emph{Say it:} \emph{pôrishrôm kôrle tumi bôṛo lôkkhyôo ôrjôn kôrte pārbe.} — With hard work you can achieve even a big goal.
  \item \emph{Recall:} say the Bengali for hard work, then the Bengali for successful, then say \emph{ôrjôn kôrā} again
\end{itemize}

\section[(dialogue)]{Looking back: from How Much to Aiming High}

\label{lesson:BN-R376-review-370-376}



\begin{quote}
Say the Bengali for very and extremely.
\end{quote}

\subsection*{Your turn}
Say these aloud:

\begin{itemize}
\raggedright
  \item very, extremely, too much, less, a bit
  \item enough, excessive, a small amount, to supply, a limit
  \item to grow, to decrease, twice as much, a level, an amount
  \item absolutely, complete, at least, nearly, partial
  \item on one's guard, to resist, to ward off, to control, a close eye
  \item compulsory, permission, an exception, to impose, to relax a rule
  \item a goal, an attempt, hard work, successful, to achieve
\end{itemize}

\begin{tcolorbox}[breakable,colback=teal!4,colframe=teal!35!black,title={Before you move on}]
Very? (\textbf{\bn{খুব}}, \emph{khub}.) Extremely? (\textbf{\bn{ভীষণ}}, \emph{bhīshôn}.) Too much? (\textbf{\bn{বেশি}}, \emph{beshi}.) Less? (\textbf{\bn{কম}}, \emph{kôm}.) A bit? (\textbf{\bn{একটু}}, \emph{ekṭu}.) Enough? (\textbf{\bn{যথেষ্ট}}, \emph{jôtheshṭô}.) Excessive? (\textbf{\bn{অতিরিক্ত}}, \emph{ôtiriktô}.) A small amount? (\textbf{\bn{অল্প}}, \emph{ôlpô}.) To supply? (\textbf{\bn{জোগানো}}, \emph{jogāno}.) A limit? (\textbf{\bn{সীমা}}, \emph{sīmā}.) To grow? (\textbf{\bn{বাড়া}}, \emph{bāṛā}.) To decrease? (\textbf{\bn{কমা}}, \emph{kômā}.) Twice as much? (\textbf{\bn{দ্বিগুণ}}, \emph{dvigun}.) A level? (\textbf{\bn{স্তর}}, \emph{stôr}.) An amount? (\textbf{\bn{পরিমাণ}}, \emph{pôrimān}.) Absolutely? (\textbf{\bn{একেবারে}}, \emph{ekebāre}.) Complete? (\textbf{\bn{সম্পূর্ণ}}, \emph{sômpūrnô}.) At least? (\textbf{\bn{অন্তত}}, \emph{ôntôtô}.) Nearly? (\textbf{\bn{প্রায়}}, \emph{prāy}.) Partial? (\textbf{\bn{আংশিক}}, \emph{āngshik}.) On one's guard? (\textbf{\bn{হুঁশিয়ার}}, \emph{hũshiyār}.) To resist? (\textbf{\bn{প্রতিরোধ} \bn{করা}}, \emph{prôtirodh kôrā}.) To ward off? (\textbf{\bn{ঠেকানো}}, \emph{ṭhekāno}.) To control? (\textbf{\bn{নিয়ন্ত্রণ} \bn{করা}}, \emph{niyôntrôn kôrā}.) A close eye? (\textbf{\bn{নজর}}, \emph{nôjôr}.) Compulsory? (\textbf{\bn{বাধ্যতামূলক}}, \emph{bādhyôtāmūlôk}.) Permission? (\textbf{\bn{অনুমতি}}, \emph{ônumôti}.) An exception? (\textbf{\bn{ব্যতিক্রম}}, \emph{bætikrôm}.) To impose? (\textbf{\bn{চাপানো}}, \emph{chāpāno}.) To relax a rule? (\textbf{\bn{শিথিল} \bn{করা}}, \emph{shithil kôrā}.) A goal? (\textbf{\bn{লক্ষ্য}}, \emph{lôkkhyô}.) An attempt? (\textbf{\bn{চেষ্টা}}, \emph{cheshṭā}.) Hard work? (\textbf{\bn{পরিশ্রম}}, \emph{pôrishrôm}.) Successful? (\textbf{\bn{সফল}}, \emph{sôphôl}.) To achieve? (\textbf{\bn{অর্জন} \bn{করা}}, \emph{ôrjôn kôrā}.)
\end{tcolorbox}
